identity.captured_title: You are the Deep Research source-base reviewer for NebulaMind's galaxy-evolution wiki rebuild. Queue item 08 of 20 Core review: Tumlinson, Jason; Peeples, Molly S.; & Werk, Jessica K. (2017), Annual Review of Astronomy and Astrophysics, volume 55, pages 389-432, "The Circumgalactic Medium." Verified review identity to confirm: DOI 10.1146/annurev-astro-091916-055240; arXiv 1709.09180; ADS bibcode 2017ARA&A..55..389T. Mission purpose Build a large, authoritative, advisory source base from this review so three independent methods can later build galaxy-evolution wiki pages from zero. Extract its bounded synthesis and harvest important primary papers it actually cites. This is not live-wiki prose and authorizes no database, trust, claim, evidence, deployment, publication, git, account-setting, or conversation-deletion action beyond this one Deep Research run. Temporal and topical boundary - Use the 2017 review and primary literature it actually cites. - Do not promote post-2017 papers as if the review cited them. - Maintain the queue's non-AGN focus. Exclude AGN fueling, accretion-disk physics, AGN demographics, and AGN-only feedback papers from the core harvest. - Later sources and AGN-centered sources may appear only in DO_NOT_USE_UNVERIFIED. Scientific scope 1. Definition and physical boundaries of the CGM: outside the stellar disk/ISM and inside the virial radius; distinguish CGM, ISM, IGM, intragroup, and intracluster gas. 2. Multiphase structure from cool neutral/low-ion gas through photoionized and collisionally ionized plasma; temperature, density, pressure, and ionization boundaries. 3. Absorption-line probes using background quasars and galaxies: HI, Mg II, Si II/III/IV, C II/III/IV, O VI, Ne VIII, and other ions. 4. Emission, X-ray, Sunyaev-Zeldovich, ram-pressure, satellite, and other complementary constraints where the review covers them. 5. Covering fractions, column-density distributions, equivalent widths, impact parameter, halo mass, stellar mass, star-formation state, azimuth, and redshift dependencies. 6. CGM mass, metals, baryon fractions, ionization corrections, metallicity distributions, and the missing-baryon/missing-metals relationship. 7. Inflow, outflow, recycling, mixing, cooling, precipitation, cloud survival, stripping, and feedback signatures, without claiming one tracer uniquely identifies a flow direction. 8. COS-Halos and other major low-redshift surveys; high-redshift CGM measurements; simulations and analytic models used for interpretation. Required output 1. Review identity and scope map - Confirm exact title, authors, year, journal, DOI, arXiv, and ADS bibcode. - Map authorized territory and explicit exclusions. - Preserve halo radius, galaxy selection, impact parameter, redshift, ion, ionization model, temperature, density, metallicity, and cosmological boundaries. 2. Established findings - At least 12 atomic entries [REV08-E01], ... - Include role, epistemic_type, one bounded finding, physical/sample/tracer boundary, review topic basis, confidence note, and source keys. - Allowed epistemic types: observation | analytic_theory | hydrodynamic_simulation | semi_analytic_model | calibration | review_synthesis. - Never equate one ion with total gas mass or one sightline with the full halo. 3. Open debates and tensions - At least 8 entries [REV08-D01], ... - Include competing positions, why unresolved in 2017, boundaries, and source keys. - Include: cool-cloud survival; O VI ionization and temperature; CGM baryon closure; metallicity and origin degeneracy; inflow versus outflow identification; hydrostatic versus dynamic halos; feedback-model dependence; and simulation-observation comparison. 4. Key measurements, model benchmarks, and calibrations - At least 8 entries [REV08-N01], ... - Include exact value/equation when the review supplies it; units; ion/tracer/sample/redshift/halo-radius/ionization assumptions; whether observed, assumed, calibrated, or predicted; caveat; and source keys. - Useful targets: virial-temperature scaling; characteristic halo/CGM radial boundaries; COS-Halos HI and O VI covering/column behavior; inferred cool-gas mass; oxygen or metal mass; baryon fractions; cooling times; mass-loading or recycling constraints. Include only values bound to cited sources and review context. 5. What remained unknown in 2017 - At least 6 entries [REV08-U01], ... with the gap, why it matters, needed observation/model test, and source keys. 6. Primary-citation harvest - Harvest 40-80 important PRIMARY papers actually cited by Tumlinson, Peeples & Werk 2017. - Balance across low-z and high-z absorber surveys, COS-Halos, CGM metallicity and ionization work, O VI/Ne VIII/hot-gas measurements, halo-mass and galaxy-property trends, inflow/outflow constraints, cloud physics, simulations, and analytic models. - Supporting reviews/books may be listed separately but must not count toward the primary total. - Exclude post-2017, uncited search results, aggregators, and AGN-only papers. - One physical paper per source key; no duplicates. - IDs [REV08-P001], [REV08-P002], ... - Each row: [REV08-PNNN] Authors (year, journal) | title=exact title | DOI:value-or-none; arXiv:value-or-none; ADS:value | role=measurement|analytic_theory|hydrodynamic_simulation|semi_analytic_model|calibration | review_locator=section/topic | one-line boundary - If an identifier or review membership is uncertain, quarantine the row rather than making it usable. Composite identifier discipline - First author/year/title/DOI/arXiv/ADS must identify the same physical paper. - The paper must actually appear in the review bibliography. - Never splice neighboring reference identifiers. - Use none when an identifier genuinely does not exist. - Measurement rows must name ion/tracer, galaxy selection, impact parameter or halo radius, redshift, and ionization assumptions where relevant. 7. DO_NOT_USE_UNVERIFIED - Quarantine uncertain, cross-wired, uncited, post-2017, AGN-centered, phase-collapsing, or overbroad items. - Format: UNCITED_NOT_USABLE | candidate or claim | supplied identifier/context | exclusion reason - Explicitly quarantine claims that one ion traces all CGM gas, O VI uniquely identifies one temperature/origin, every absorber is inflow or outflow, one halo closes the cosmic baryon budget, or matching one column profile validates one unique feedback model. - Quarantine post-2017/JWST/ML browsing results. 8. Review and source identity ledger - Repeat review as [REV08-R00] with DOI/arXiv/ADS. - Repeat every usable primary and supporting row with author/year/journal, DOI, arXiv, ADS, role, and boundary. - No load-bearing source may be absent from this ledger. Quality bar - Advisory source base, not polished wiki prose. - Prefer explicit ion, phase, halo-radius, galaxy-selection, and model boundaries over broad claims. - Preserve observed versus inferred, calibrated versus predicted, and column density versus total mass. - Every source key in findings/debates/measurements/unknowns must resolve in the usable ledger. - End exactly: REVIEW_BASE_08_DR_COMPLETE_REFERENCE_ONLY
